summary: WISeKey International Holding AG filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Swiss Takeover Board decision validating the company's opting-out clause in connection with its planned cross-border merger with WISeKey International Corp. The decision confirms the opting-out provision will be effective if incorporated into the articles of association before the merger becomes legally effective, allowing the combined entity to list on SIX Swiss Exchange and Nasdaq without mandatory takeover rules. Shareholders holding at least 3% of voting rights have five trading days to object. The merger is part of a structural reorganization that may also involve a redomiciliation from Switzerland, subject to regulatory approval.
